cases.refreshed: Join us to create your own pop art image. We will be using iPads, Apple pencils, the Sketchbook app and Keynote. Explore different features across these apps to learn the fundamentals of photo editing. Transforming ordinary objects, such as figurines and erasers, allows participants to find artistic and scientific beauty in the world around them. Recommended for ages 8 and up. No experience required.
